steps.title: Start with one row per set of side lengths
steps.change: Every row must receive a classification. Read TRIANGLES and calculate the label in SELECT.
steps.added_sql: SELECT A, B, C FROM TRIANGLES;
steps.sql: SELECT A, B, C FROM TRIANGLES;

steps.title: Reject invalid triangles first
steps.change: Each pair of sides must add up to strictly more than the remaining side. Any failed pair makes the row Not A Triangle. Use OR because one failed comparison is sufficient. Equality is invalid too, as with 2 + 3 = 5.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT A, B, C,
       CASE WHEN A+B <= C OR A+C <= B OR B+C <= A
            THEN 'Not A Triangle' ELSE 'Continue' END AS check_result
FROM TRIANGLES;
steps.sql:
SELECT A, B, C,
       CASE WHEN A+B <= C OR A+C <= B OR B+C <= A
            THEN 'Not A Triangle' ELSE 'Continue' END AS check_result
FROM TRIANGLES;

steps.title: Check all equal, then all different
steps.change: For valid rows, all equal sides produce Equilateral. All three pairwise inequalities produce Scalene. A CASE stops at its first true branch.
steps.added_sql:
CASE
           WHEN A+B <= C OR A+C <= B OR B+C <= A THEN 'Not A Triangle'
           WHEN A=B AND B=C AND C=A THEN 'Equilateral'
           WHEN A!=B AND B!=C AND C!=A THEN 'Scalene'
           ELSE 'Continue'
       END AS check_result
steps.sql:
SELECT A, B, C,
       CASE
           WHEN A+B <= C OR A+C <= B OR B+C <= A THEN 'Not A Triangle'
           WHEN A=B AND B=C AND C=A THEN 'Equilateral'
           WHEN A!=B AND B!=C AND C!=A THEN 'Scalene'
           ELSE 'Continue'
       END AS check_result
FROM TRIANGLES;

steps.title: Check the equal pair and return the requested column
steps.change: Your final branch tests each possible equal pair while requiring the third side to differ. All possible classifications are covered for non-NULL side lengths.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT
-- …
        WHEN (A + B <= C) OR (A + C <= B) OR (B + C <= A)
            THEN 'Not A Triangle'
        WHEN A = B AND B = C AND C = A
            THEN 'Equilateral'
        WHEN A != B AND B != C AND C != A
            THEN 'Scalene'
        WHEN (A = B AND B != C)
          OR (B = C AND C != A)
          OR (C = A AND A != B)
            THEN 'Isosceles'
    END AS TriangleType
